answer: The inlet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A vault of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
